purpose: Executable ledger for the `symmetry-anomaly-conservation` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Anomaly matching or cancellation is necessary for some claims but not sufficient for candidate identity, public-record closure, or ToE support.

anomaly_rows.anomaly_object: mixed bulk-boundary or generalized-symmetry anomaly matching inside the declared code subspace
anomaly_rows.matching_or_cancellation_condition: Declare whether the route needs anomaly cancellation, anomaly inflow, t Hooft anomaly matching, Ward-identity preservation, gravitational anomaly control, split-symmetry restoration, duality-defect consistency, or an explicit statement that no anomaly claim is being made.
anomaly_rows.mismatch_failure_mode: Failure can appear as unmatched UV/IR anomaly, gauge anomaly, gravitational anomaly, global-symmetry residue, non-invertible-defect mismatch, regulator-induced Ward violation, selected-sector cancellation, or a cancellation that holds only after borrowing another framework.
anomaly_rows.anomaly_test: Compare source and target anomaly data across the declared symmetry action, quotient, sector, regulator, and public-record object; cap anomaly-free or matched language if the matching is only presentation-level, local-sector, or metadata-level.
anomaly_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer anomaly freedom, no-global-symmetry compliance, duality identity, or UV completion from a formal symmetry label, compactification atlas entry, gauge-fixed calculation, or selected cancellation without route-local matching data.
